import unittest

from solution import LinearComplexSystem


class LinearComplexSystemTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertComplexListAlmostEqual(self, actual, expected):
        self.assertEqual(len(actual), len(expected))
        for left, right in zip(actual, expected):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(left.real, complex(right).real)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(left.imag, complex(right).imag)

    def test_solves_with_partial_pivoting_and_is_repeatable(self):
        system = LinearComplexSystem([[0, 1], [1, 1]], [2, 3])
        first = system.solve()
        second = system.solve()
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(first, [1, 2])
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(second, [1, 2])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        first[0] = 999
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(system.solve(), [1, 2])

    def test_complex_solution_and_residual(self):
        system = LinearComplexSystem([[1, 1], [1, -1]], [1 + 1j, 3 - 1j])
        answer = system.solve()
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(answer, [2, -1 + 1j])
        residual1 = system.residual(answer)
        residual2 = system.residual(answer)
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(residual1, [0, 0])
        self.assertIsNot(residual1, residual2)
        residual1.append(10)
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(system.residual(answer), [0, 0])

    def test_constructor_copies_inputs(self):
        coefficients = [[2, 0], [0, 4]]
        constants = [6, 8]
        system = LinearComplexSystem(coefficients, constants)
        coefficients[0][0] = 100
        coefficients.append([1, 1])
        constants[0] = 100
        constants.append(9)
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(system.solve(), [3, 2])

    def test_zero_dimensional_system(self):
        system = LinearComplexSystem([], [])
        first = system.solve()
        second = system.solve()
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertEqual(system.residual([]), [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_singular_matrix(self):
        system = LinearComplexSystem([[1, 2], [2, 4]], [3, 6])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            system.solve()

    def test_shape_validation(self):
        malformed = [
            ([[1, 2]], [1]),
            ([[1], [2]], [1, 2]),
            ([[1, 0], [0, 1]], [1]),
        ]
        for coefficients, constants in malformed:
            with self.subTest(coefficients=coefficients, constants=constants):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    LinearComplexSystem(coefficients, constants)

    def test_type_validation(self):
        cases = [
            (((1,),), [1]),
            ([[1]], (1,)),
            ([1], [1]),
            ([[True]], [1]),
            ([[1]], [False]),
            ([["1"]], [1]),
        ]
        for coefficients, constants in cases:
            with self.subTest(coefficients=coefficients, constants=constants):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    LinearComplexSystem(coefficients, constants)

    def test_residual_validation_and_input_stability(self):
        system = LinearComplexSystem([[2, 1], [1, 3]], [4, 7])
        candidate = [1, 2]
        snapshot = candidate.copy()
        self.assertComplexListAlmostEqual(system.residual(candidate), [0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(candidate, snapshot)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            system.residual((1, 2))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            system.residual([1, True])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            system.residual([1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
